* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 2, file created 2 February 2025: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds one battle destiny with Chewie. While piloting Falcon, adds 2 to maneuver and, once during battle, may re-circulate.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Han Solo (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Han Solo”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Han Solo (V)]] (published 30 December 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Han Solo]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
